name: io.github.brandyn-s/code-search
title: code-search
description: Hybrid semantic + lexical code search with per-project indexes and checkout-bound evidence.

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Use Voyage AI embeddings (voyage-4-large) instead of the local model.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables Sonnet reranking of the top hybrid candidates.

environmentVariables.name: CODE_SEARCH_STORAGE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Directory for indexes and local models (default ~/.claude_code_search).

environmentVariables.name: RERANKER
environmentVariables.description: Optional. auto (default), sonnet, listwise, cross-encoder, or off.
